Use `useLayoutEffect` when you need to measure or change the DOM before the browser paints, for example reading `getBoundingClientRect` to position a tooltip, or fixing scroll position after content changes, so there's no visible flicker. Use `useEffect` for everything else such as fetching, subscriptions and logging, because it runs after paint and doesn't block rendering. Action: none.

That error means Docker is looking at the old Docker Desktop socket path. With OrbStack, `docker context` or DOCKER_HOST should point at OrbStack's socket instead. Testcontainers needs Docker reachable too, and the api tests hang rather than fail when it isn't. Action: run `docker context ls`, check `echo $DOCKER_HOST` and `docker info`, switch to the OrbStack context, then retry `docker compose up -d db redis`.

Keep-alive just reuses one TCP connection for several requests, but on HTTP/1.1 they still go one at a time, so browsers open several connections per host. HTTP/2 multiplexing interleaves many concurrent requests and responses as streams over a single connection, with header compression on top. They aren't the same thing. Action: none.

tsx transpiles with esbuild and strips types without type-checking, which makes it fast and handles ESM and CJS interop with no config. ts-node uses the TypeScript compiler, type-checks by default and is slower, and ESM needs extra setup. Use `tsc --noEmit` for the type checks separately with tsx. Action: none; tell me when to run the install so the lockfile picks up tsx.

There's a real difference. structuredClone keeps Dates, Maps, Sets and typed arrays and handles circular references; the JSON round trip turns Dates into strings, drops undefined and functions, empties Maps and Sets, and throws on cycles. Neither copies functions, and structuredClone throws on them. Action: none.

With next-themes' class strategy, dark styling comes from Tailwind `dark:` variants, so the badge is probably using light-only colors. InvoiceStatusBadge takes a `status` prop (draft, sent, paid, overdue, void), so each of those needs a dark variant. Action: check that Tailwind's darkMode is set to class, add dark: variants for every status in the badge, and verify by toggling the theme.

`using x = getResource()` calls `x[Symbol.dispose]()` when the scope exits, even on throw, and multiple `using` declarations dispose in reverse order. `await using` does the same with `Symbol.asyncDispose` for async cleanup. It needs TS 5.2, an esnext lib setting for the disposable types, and runtime support or a polyfill for the symbols. Action: none.

The common thread is TS1484: with verbatimModuleSyntax on, anything that is only a type has to be imported with `import type` or an inline `type` modifier, and these files import types as plain values. The log is cut off, so there may be more of the same. Action: apply the type-only import fix across the flagged files in web and api, and re-run the typecheck to confirm the count goes to zero.
